title: Read offsets repeatedly expand into huge invalid values
details:
**What happened:** Model repeatedly converted ordinary line offsets into 14–16 digit values, causing `file is shorter than provided offset`, then also generated malformed file paths despite an existing memory warning to switch to `sed` after the first failure.
**What the user said:** User didn't comment; observed by the model.
**Repro:** Continue a long compacted code-edit session, request a small source excerpt around line 350 or 700, then inspect generated Read arguments.
**Evidence:** Session f54f60e0-b7c5-41e1-ae43-15541d906805; memory/stop-repeating-invalid-read-offsets.md; affected task-book path docs/04-management/EAM开发任务书-20260826.md.
